text: The coefficient of (z - z0)^(-1) in the Laurent expansion of f about an isolated singularity z0 is called the ___ of f at z0.
explanation: The residue is the coefficient a_{-1} of the Laurent series; the residue theorem sums 2*pi*i times these residues over the enclosed singularities to evaluate a contour integral. Only the (z - z0)^(-1) term survives integration around the singularity.
